set.body: M1 of docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. Turn docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md into an executable contract at the pinned eyesim revision. Enumerate methods, estimands, conventions, backend dependencies and fixtures within every required row. Classify coverage as verified equivalent, intentional divergence with independent evidence, or an implementation gap. Include a basic leakage-free template-model workflow; advanced fit families may be explicitly deferred. Exit: fixture inputs and regeneration procedure pinned, independent analytic/small-instance cases selected, exact implementation tasks attached for every gap. Reuse v-parity and migration work for the harness and reporting.
set.title: Pin eyesim baseline workflows and scientific acceptance cases
